description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police inspector in his late 30s. He is wearing a crisp, dark navy blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including a peaked cap, silver badges on the chest, and tactical duty belt. He has a clean-shaven face, short-cropped black hair, and polished black boots.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his early 20s. He is wearing a casual white button-down shirt tucked into slim-fit beige chinos with brown loafers. He has a youthful appearance with short, neat black hair and a slim build, representing a modern young professional.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette made of flickering digital static and deep shadows. The figure wears a dark, semi-transparent police officer's cap, but has no face. A faint red glowing pulse emanates from the center of its chest.

FULL BODY. A featureless human figure with a smooth, matte-black surface like a mannequin. It is dressed in a faint, holographic outline of a formal suit. Its head is replaced by a glowing, pixelated government emblem that glitches intermittently.
